mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past two months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the past three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS shows a sustained decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) shows an annualized growth rate below 2%, it signals a potential monetary policy over-tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5% and CPIAUCSL annualized growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the past month, combined with an increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points, signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS decreases by more than 100k and UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over the past three months signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and the GDP (GDPC1) shows a quarter-over-quarter growth rate above 2%, it signals a robust supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 12mo MA and GDPC1 QoQ growth > 2%
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average and GDPC1 shows a QoQ growth rate above 2%.
